examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تحويل العمر من الأرض إلى المريخ مع تنسيق الإخراج.
examples.descEn: Learn to convert age from Earth to Mars with formatted output.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MARSAGE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 EARTH-AGE PIC 9(2) VALUE 25.
       01 MARS-AGE PIC 9(2)V9.
       01 DISP-AGE PIC Z9.9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           COMPUTE MARS-AGE = EARTH-AGE * 1.88
           MOVE MARS-AGE TO DISP-AGE
           DISPLAY "Age on Mars: " DISP-AGE " years"
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تعريف مصفوفة من 5 عناصر وقراءة قيمها وعرضها.
examples.descEn: Learn to define an array of 5 elements, read its values, and display them.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ARRAY.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-ARR.
          05 WS-ELEM PIC 9(2) OCCURS 5.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               DISPLAY 'ENTER ELEMENT ' WS-I ': '
               ACCEPT WS-ELEM(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY 'ARRAY CONTENTS:'
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               DISPLAY WS-ELEM(WS-I)
           END-PERFORM.
           STOP RUN.

ENTER ELEMENT 03:

ARRAY CONTENTS:
10
20
30
40
50

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة قائمة أرقام وحساب متوسطها باستخدام COMPUTE و DISPLAY مع تنسيق الإخراج.
examples.descEn: Learn to read a list of numbers and compute their average using COMPUTE and DISPLAY with formatted output.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. AVGLIST.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(3).
       01 I PIC 9(3).
       01 X PIC 9(5).
       01 WS-SUM PIC 9(6) VALUE 0.
       01 AVG PIC 9(6)V99.
       01 AVG-OUT PIC Z(5).99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT N
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > N
               ACCEPT X
               ADD X TO WS-SUM
           END-PERFORM
           COMPUTE AVG = WS-SUM / N
           MOVE AVG TO AVG-OUT
           DISPLAY "Average: " FUNCTION TRIM(AVG-OUT)
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تحويل رقم عشري إلى تمثيله الثنائي باستخدام القسمة المتكررة.
examples.descEn: Learn to convert a decimal number to its binary representation using repeated division.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BINCONV.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N        PIC 9(3) VALUE 13.
       01 BIN-STR  PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.
       01 TEMP     PIC 9(3).
       01 REM      PIC 9(3).
       01 IDX      PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE N TO TEMP.
           PERFORM UNTIL TEMP = 0
               DIVIDE TEMP BY 2 GIVING TEMP REMAINDER REM
               IF REM = 1 THEN
                   STRING '1' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO BIN-STR
                       WITH POINTER IDX
               ELSE
                   STRING '0' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO BIN-STR
                       WITH POINTER IDX
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY FUNCTION REVERSE(BIN-STR).
           STOP RUN.

examples.titleEn: Binary Search in a Sorted Array
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية البحث الثنائي في COBOL مع تحديث الحدود العلوية والسفلية.
examples.descEn: Learn binary search in COBOL with updating low and high bounds.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BINSEARCH.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ARR.
          05 ARR-ELEM PIC 9(3) OCCURS 6.
       01 LOW PIC 9(1).
       01 HIGH PIC 9(1).
       01 MID PIC 9(1).
       01 TARGET PIC 9(3).
       01 FOUND PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 5 TO ARR-ELEM(1)
           MOVE 12 TO ARR-ELEM(2)
           MOVE 18 TO ARR-ELEM(3)
           MOVE 23 TO ARR-ELEM(4)
           MOVE 37 TO ARR-ELEM(5)
           MOVE 42 TO ARR-ELEM(6)
           MOVE 23 TO TARGET
           MOVE 1 TO LOW
           MOVE 6 TO HIGH
           PERFORM UNTIL LOW > HIGH
               COMPUTE MID = (LOW + HIGH) / 2
               IF ARR-ELEM(MID) = TARGET
                   MOVE 'Y' TO FOUND
                   DISPLAY 'FOUND AT ' MID
                   MOVE HIGH TO LOW
                   MOVE 0 TO HIGH
               ELSE
                   IF ARR-ELEM(MID) < TARGET
                       ADD 1 TO LOW
                   ELSE
                       SUBTRACT 1 FROM HIGH
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF FOUND = 'N'
               DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND'
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام عملية AND المنطقية مع 1 لتحديد زوجية العدد بسرعة.
examples.descEn: Learn to use a logical AND with 1 to quickly determine if a number is even or odd.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EVENODD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(2) VALUE 7.
       01 R PIC 9.
       01 DISP-N PIC Z9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE N TO DISP-N
           COMPUTE R = FUNCTION MOD(N, 2)
           IF R = 0
               DISPLAY DISP-N " is even"
           ELSE
               DISPLAY DISP-N " is odd"
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام الحلقات والصور الرقمية في COBOL لطباعة أغنية تنازلية.
examples.descEn: Learn to use loops and numeric pictures in COBOL to print a countdown song.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BOTTLES.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 BOTTLES PIC 99.
       01 BOTTLES-DISP PIC Z9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING BOTTLES FROM 3 BY -1 UNTIL BOTTLES = 0
               MOVE BOTTLES TO BOTTLES-DISP
               DISPLAY BOTTLES-DISP " bottles of beer on the wall, "
                       BOTTLES-DISP " bottles of beer."
               IF BOTTLES = 1
                   DISPLAY "Take one down and pass it around, no more bottles of beer on the wall."
               ELSE
                   COMPUTE BOTTLES = BOTTLES - 1
                   MOVE BOTTLES TO BOTTLES-DISP
                   DISPLAY "Take one down and pass it around, "
                           BOTTLES-DISP " bottles of beer on the wall."
                   ADD 1 TO BOTTLES
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           STOP RUN.

3 bottles of beer on the wall,  3 bottles of beer.
Take one down and pass it around,  2 bottles of beer on the wall.
 2 bottles of beer on the wall,  2 bottles of beer.
Take one down and pass it around,  1 bottles of beer on the wall.
 1 bottles of beer on the wall,  1 bottles of beer.
Take one down and pass it around, no more bottles of beer on the wall.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تنفيذ الفرز الفقاعي في COBOL مع تبادل العناصر.
examples.descEn: Learn bubble sort in COBOL with swapping elements.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BUBBLESORT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ARR.
          05 ARR-ELEM PIC 9(3) OCCURS 5.
       01 I PIC 9(1).
       01 J PIC 9(1).
       01 TEMP PIC 9(3).
       01 SWAPPED PIC X(1) VALUE 'Y'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 64 TO ARR-ELEM(1)
           MOVE 34 TO ARR-ELEM(2)
           MOVE 25 TO ARR-ELEM(3)
           MOVE 12 TO ARR-ELEM(4)
           MOVE 22 TO ARR-ELEM(5)
           PERFORM UNTIL SWAPPED = 'N'
               MOVE 'N' TO SWAPPED
               PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I >= 5
                   IF ARR-ELEM(I) > ARR-ELEM(I + 1)
                       MOVE ARR-ELEM(I) TO TEMP
                       MOVE ARR-ELEM(I + 1) TO ARR-ELEM(I)
                       MOVE TEMP TO ARR-ELEM(I + 1)
                       MOVE 'Y' TO SWAPPED
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 5
               DISPLAY ARR-ELEM(I)
           END-PERFORM
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام IF المركبة مع AND لتصفية القيم قبل جمعها.
examples.descEn: Learn to use compound IF with AND to filter values before summing.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CondSum.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2).
       01 WS-SUM PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 WS-DISP PIC ZZ9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 10
               IF WS-I > 3 AND WS-I < 8
                   ADD WS-I TO WS-SUM
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-SUM TO WS-DISP
           DISPLAY WS-DISP
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تعريف ثابت واستخدامه في العمليات الحسابية.
examples.descEn: Learn to define a constant and use it in arithmetic operations.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CONST.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-PI CONSTANT AS 3.14.
       01 WS-RADIUS PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01 WS-AREA PIC 9(3)V99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           COMPUTE WS-AREA = WS-PI * WS-RADIUS * WS-RADIUS.
           DISPLAY 'AREA = ' WS-AREA.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب أن القسمة على صفر تسبب خطأً في COBOL، وكيفية تجنبها بالتحقق قبل القسمة.
examples.descEn: Learn that division by zero causes an error in COBOL, and how to avoid it by checking before dividing.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DIVZERO.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 A PIC 9(3) VALUE 100.
       01 B PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 RESULT PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           IF B = 0
               DISPLAY "ERROR: DIVISION BY ZERO"
           ELSE
               DIVIDE A BY B GIVING RESULT
               DISPLAY "RESULT: " RESULT
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تنفيذ خوارزمية إقليدس في COBOL باستخدام القسمة المتكررة.
examples.descEn: Learn Euclid's algorithm in COBOL using repeated division.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GCD.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 A PIC 9(3).
       01 B PIC 9(3).
       01 R PIC 9(3).
       01 DISP PIC ZZ9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 48 TO A
           MOVE 36 TO B
           PERFORM UNTIL B = 0
               DIVIDE A BY B GIVING R REMAINDER R
               MOVE B TO A
               MOVE R TO B
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE A TO DISP
           DISPLAY DISP
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام عبارة EVALUATE (بديل switch) لتصنيف الدرجات.
examples.descEn: Learn to use EVALUATE (switch equivalent) to classify grades.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GradeEval.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-SCORE PIC 9(3) VALUE 85.
       01 WS-GRADE PIC X(1).
       01 WS-DISP PIC Z(2)9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 90
                   MOVE 'A' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 80
                   MOVE 'B' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 70
                   MOVE 'C' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN WS-SCORE >= 60
                   MOVE 'D' TO WS-GRADE
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE 'F' TO WS-GRADE
           END-EVALUATE
           MOVE WS-SCORE TO WS-DISP
           DISPLAY 'Score ' WS-DISP ' Grade ' WS-GRADE
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب كيفية حساب مضروب عدد صحيح باستخدام حلقة PERFORM في COBOL.
examples.descEn: Learn how to compute the factorial of an integer using a PERFORM loop in COBOL.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FACTORIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N        PIC 9(3) VALUE 8.
       01 RESULT   PIC 9(10) VALUE 1.
       01 I        PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > N
               MULTIPLY RESULT BY I GIVING RESULT
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY RESULT.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب توليد متتالية فيبوناتشي باستخدام متغيرات مؤقتة وحلقة PERFORM.
examples.descEn: Learn to generate the Fibonacci sequence using temporary variables and a PERFORM loop.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FIBO.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(2) VALUE 10.
       01 A PIC 9(10) VALUE 0.
       01 B PIC 9(10) VALUE 1.
       01 C PIC 9(10).
       01 I PIC 9(2).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY A.
           DISPLAY B.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 3 BY 1 UNTIL I > N
               COMPUTE C = A + B
               DISPLAY C
               MOVE B TO A
               MOVE C TO B
           END-PERFORM.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب كيفية التعامل مع دقة الفاصلة العائمة في COBOL باستخدام COMPUTE.
examples.descEn: Learn how to handle floating point precision in COBOL using COMPUTE.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FLOATPREC.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 A PIC 9(3)V9(2) VALUE 1.23.
       01 B PIC 9(3)V9(2) VALUE 4.56.
       01 C PIC 9(3)V9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           COMPUTE C = A * B.
           DISPLAY C.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تعريف مصفوفة وجمع عناصرها باستخدام PERFORM.
examples.descEn: Learn to define an array and sum its elements using PERFORM.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FOLDSUM.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ARR.
          05 X PIC 9(2) OCCURS 5.
       01 I PIC 9.
       01 WS-SUM PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 DISP-SUM PIC Z(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1 TO X(1)
           MOVE 2 TO X(2)
           MOVE 3 TO X(3)
           MOVE 4 TO X(4)
           MOVE 5 TO X(5)
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 5
               ADD X(I) TO WS-SUM
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE WS-SUM TO DISP-SUM
           DISPLAY 'Sum = ' DISP-SUM
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام PERFORM VARYING لتكرار عدد محدد من المرات وطباعة الأرقام.
examples.descEn: Learn to use PERFORM VARYING to repeat a fixed number of times and print numbers.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FORLOOP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-I > 5
               DISPLAY 'NUMBER: ' WS-I
           END-PERFORM.
           STOP RUN.

examples.titleEn: Format a Number with Leading Zeros
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام صورة العرض PIC ZZ9 لإزالة الأصفار البادئة عند الطباعة.
examples.descEn: Learn to use PIC ZZ9 edit pattern to suppress leading zeros when printing.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FORMAT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM PIC 9(3) VALUE 7.
       01 WS-DISP PIC ZZ9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE WS-NUM TO WS-DISP
           DISPLAY WS-DISP
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب إنشاء برنامج فرعي (دالة) لحساب مربع رقم واستدعاءه من البرنامج الرئيسي.
examples.descEn: Learn to create a subprogram (function) to compute the square of a number and call it from the main program.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MAIN.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM PIC 9(2) VALUE 7.
       01 WS-RESULT PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           CALL 'SQUARE' USING WS-NUM WS-RESULT.
           DISPLAY 'SQUARE OF ' WS-NUM ' IS ' WS-RESULT.
           STOP RUN.
       END PROGRAM MAIN.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SQUARE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01 LS-NUM PIC 9(2).
       01 LS-RESULT PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-NUM LS-RESULT.
           COMPUTE LS-RESULT = LS-NUM * LS-NUM.
           EXIT PROGRAM.
       END PROGRAM SQUARE.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام جملة IF لاتخاذ قرار بناءً على قيمة مدخلة.
examples.descEn: Learn to use IF statement to make a decision based on an input value.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. IFELSE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM PIC 9(2).
       01 WS-RESULT PIC X(10).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'ENTER A NUMBER: '.
           ACCEPT WS-NUM.
           IF WS-NUM > 10
               MOVE 'LARGE' TO WS-RESULT
           ELSE
               MOVE 'SMALL' TO WS-RESULT
           END-IF.
           DISPLAY 'THE NUMBER IS ' WS-RESULT.
           STOP RUN.
examples.expectedStdout:
ENTER A NUMBER: 
THE NUMBER IS LARGE

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب أن الوصول إلى عنصر خارج حدود الجدول يسبب خطأً، وكيفية التحقق من الفهرس قبل الوصول.
examples.descEn: Learn that accessing an element outside table bounds causes an error, and how to check the index before accessing.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. IDXOUT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 TBL.
          05 TBL-ELEM PIC 9(3) OCCURS 5.
       01 IDX PIC 9(3).
       01 VAL PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1 TO TBL-ELEM(1)
           MOVE 2 TO TBL-ELEM(2)
           MOVE 3 TO TBL-ELEM(3)
           MOVE 4 TO TBL-ELEM(4)
           MOVE 5 TO TBL-ELEM(5)
           MOVE 6 TO IDX
           IF IDX >= 1 AND IDX <= 5
               MOVE TBL-ELEM(IDX) TO VAL
               DISPLAY "VALUE: " VAL
           ELSE
               DISPLAY "ERROR: INDEX OUT OF RANGE"
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة نص من المستخدم وعرضه مع الانتباه إلى أن الحقل المحدد بطول 20 يضيف مسافات.
examples.descEn: Learn to read a string and display it, noting that a PIC X(20) field pads with spaces.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. IO.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME PIC X(20).
       01 WS-DISPLAY PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'ENTER YOUR NAME: '.
           ACCEPT WS-NAME.
           MOVE WS-NAME TO WS-DISPLAY
           DISPLAY 'HELLO, ' FUNCTION TRIM(WS-DISPLAY) '!'.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب التحقق من صحة المدخلات قبل استخدامها لتجنب الأخطاء.
examples.descEn: Learn to validate input before using it to avoid errors.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INPVAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 INP PIC X(10).
       01 NUM PIC 9(5).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT INP
           IF INP IS NUMERIC
               MOVE INP TO NUM
               DISPLAY "VALID: " NUM
           ELSE
               DISPLAY "ERROR: NOT NUMERIC"
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب أن تحويل نص غير رقمي إلى رقم يسبب خطأً، وكيفية التحقق من صحة النص قبل التحويل.
examples.descEn: Learn that converting a non-numeric string to a number causes an error, and how to validate the string before converting.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. INVCONV.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 STR-IN PIC X(5) VALUE "12A34".
       01 NUM-OUT PIC 9(5).
       01 CHK PIC 9(5).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL(STR-IN) TO CHK
           IF CHK = 0
               DISPLAY "ERROR: INVALID NUMERIC"
           ELSE
               MOVE CHK TO NUM-OUT
               DISPLAY "NUM: " NUM-OUT
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تنفيذ البحث الخطي في COBOL باستخدام حلقة PERFORM والتحقق من كل عنصر.
examples.descEn: Learn to implement linear search in COBOL using a PERFORM loop and checking each element.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LINSEARCH.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ARR.
          05 ARR-ELEM PIC 9(3) OCCURS 5.
       01 I PIC 9(1).
       01 TARGET PIC 9(3).
       01 FOUND PIC X(1) VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 10 TO ARR-ELEM(1)
           MOVE 25 TO ARR-ELEM(2)
           MOVE 30 TO ARR-ELEM(3)
           MOVE 45 TO ARR-ELEM(4)
           MOVE 60 TO ARR-ELEM(5)
           MOVE 45 TO TARGET
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 5
               IF ARR-ELEM(I) = TARGET
                   MOVE 'Y' TO FOUND
                   DISPLAY 'FOUND AT ' I
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           IF FOUND = 'N'
               DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND'
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب حساب الوسيط لمصفوفة مرتبة، مع التعامل مع الحالتين: الفردية والزوجية.
examples.descEn: Learn to compute the median of a sorted array, handling both odd and even cases.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. MEDIAN.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ARR.
          05 ARR-ELEM PIC 9(3) OCCURS 5.
       01 N PIC 9 VALUE 5.
       01 MID PIC 9.
       01 MED PIC 9(3)V9.
       01 OUT-MED PIC Z9.9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 10 TO ARR-ELEM(1)
           MOVE 20 TO ARR-ELEM(2)
           MOVE 30 TO ARR-ELEM(3)
           MOVE 40 TO ARR-ELEM(4)
           MOVE 50 TO ARR-ELEM(5)
           DIVIDE N BY 2 GIVING MID
           IF FUNCTION MOD(N, 2) = 1
               ADD 1 TO MID
               MOVE ARR-ELEM(MID) TO MED
           ELSE
               COMPUTE MED = (ARR-ELEM(MID) + ARR-ELEM(MID + 1)) / 2
           END-IF
           MOVE MED TO OUT-MED
           DISPLAY "MEDIAN=" OUT-MED
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب حساب المضروب باستخدام حلقة PERFORM في سطر واحد.
examples.descEn: Learn to compute factorial using a PERFORM loop in one line.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. FACT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01 RES PIC 9(4) VALUE 1.
       01 I PIC 9(2).
       01 DISP-RES PIC Z(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > N
               COMPUTE RES = RES * I
           END-PERFORM
           MOVE RES TO DISP-RES
           DISPLAY "5! = " DISP-RES
           STOP RUN.

examples.titleEn: Check if a String is a Palindrome
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب مقارنة النص مع نسخته المعكوسة لتحديد إذا كان جناساً.
examples.descEn: Learn to compare a string with its reverse to determine if it is a palindrome.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PALIN.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STR PIC X(5) VALUE 'RADAR'.
       01 WS-REV PIC X(5).
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2).
       01 WS-J PIC 9(2).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1 TO WS-J.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 5 BY -1 UNTIL WS-I = 0
               MOVE WS-STR(WS-I:1) TO WS-REV(WS-J:1)
               ADD 1 TO WS-J
           END-PERFORM
           IF WS-STR = WS-REV
               DISPLAY 'PALINDROME'
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'NOT PALINDROME'
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب فحص ما إذا كان العدد يقرأ بنفس الشكل من اليسار واليمين.
examples.descEn: Learn to check if a number reads the same forwards and backwards.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PALINDROME.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(4) VALUE 1221.
       01 ORIG PIC 9(4).
       01 REV PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 DIGIT PIC 9(4).
       01 TEMP PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE N TO ORIG
           MOVE N TO TEMP
           PERFORM UNTIL TEMP = 0
               DIVIDE TEMP BY 10 GIVING TEMP REMAINDER DIGIT
               COMPUTE REV = REV * 10 + DIGIT
           END-PERFORM
           IF ORIG = REV
               DISPLAY N " IS PALINDROME"
           ELSE
               DISPLAY N " IS NOT PALINDROME"
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة سطر مفصول بفواصل وفصل الحقول باستخدام UNSTRING.
examples.descEn: Learn to read a comma-separated line and split fields using UNSTRING.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CSV.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 LINE-IN PIC X(80).
       01 F1 PIC X(20).
       01 F2 PIC X(20).
       01 F3 PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT LINE-IN
           UNSTRING LINE-IN DELIMITED BY ','
               INTO F1 F2 F3
           END-UNSTRING
           DISPLAY "1:" FUNCTION TRIM(F1)
           DISPLAY "2:" FUNCTION TRIM(F2)
           DISPLAY "3:" FUNCTION TRIM(F3)
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب بناء مثلث باسكال باستخدام مصفوفة ثنائية الأبعاد والعمليات الحسابية على المؤشرات.
examples.descEn: Learn to build Pascal's triangle using a 2D array and arithmetic operations on indices.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PASCAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ROWS PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01 TRI.
          05 ROW OCCURS 10.
             10 VAL PIC 9(3) OCCURS 10.
       01 I PIC 9(2).
       01 J PIC 9(2).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > ROWS
               MOVE 1 TO VAL(I,1) VAL(I,I)
               PERFORM VARYING J FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL J >= I
                   COMPUTE VAL(I,J) = VAL(I - 1,J - 1) + VAL(I - 1,J)
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > ROWS
               PERFORM VARYING J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL J > I
                   DISPLAY VAL(I,J)
               END-PERFORM
           END-PERFORM.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب التحقق مما إذا كان العدد مثاليًا بجمع قواسمه.
examples.descEn: Learn to check if a number is perfect by summing its divisors.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PERFECT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(3) VALUE 28.
       01 SUM-DIV PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 I PIC 9(3).
       01 REM PIC 9(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I >= N
               DIVIDE N BY I GIVING REM REMAINDER REM
               IF REM = 0 THEN
                   ADD I TO SUM-DIV
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM.
           IF SUM-DIV = N THEN
               DISPLAY 'PERFECT'
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'NOT PERFECT'
           END-IF.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام حلقة PERFORM مع شرط الخروج المبكر للتحقق من الأعداد الأولية.
examples.descEn: Learn to use PERFORM loop with early exit condition to check for prime numbers.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PrimeChk.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-N PIC 9(3) VALUE 29.
       01 WS-I PIC 9(3).
       01 WS-IS-PRIME PIC X VALUE 'Y'.
       01 WS-DISP PIC Z(2)9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           IF WS-N < 2
               MOVE 'N' TO WS-IS-PRIME
           ELSE
               PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 2 BY 1
                       UNTIL WS-I * WS-I > WS-N OR WS-IS-PRIME = 'N'
                   IF FUNCTION MOD(WS-N, WS-I) = 0
                       MOVE 'N' TO WS-IS-PRIME
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-N TO WS-DISP
           IF WS-IS-PRIME = 'Y'
               DISPLAY WS-DISP ' is prime'
           ELSE
               DISPLAY WS-DISP ' is not prime'
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب كيفية استخدام الحلقات والشروط في COBOL لفحص ما إذا كان الرقم أوليًا.
examples.descEn: Learn how to use loops and conditions in COBOL to check if a number is prime.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PRIME.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N        PIC 9(3).
       01 I        PIC 9(3).
       01 REM      PIC 9(3).
       01 IS-PRIME PIC X VALUE 'Y'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 29 TO N.
           IF N < 2 THEN
               MOVE 'N' TO IS-PRIME
           ELSE
               PERFORM VARYING I FROM 2 BY 1 UNTIL I > N / 2
                   DIVIDE N BY I GIVING REM REMAINDER REM
                   IF REM = 0 THEN
                       MOVE 'N' TO IS-PRIME
                   END-IF
               END-PERFORM
           END-IF.
           IF IS-PRIME = 'Y' THEN
               DISPLAY 'PRIME'
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'NOT PRIME'
           END-IF.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب بناء طابور دائري بمصفوفة ثابتة مع عمليات الإدخال والإخراج والطباعة.
examples.descEn: Learn to build a circular queue with a fixed array, including enqueue, dequeue, and print.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. QUEUE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 Q-ARR PIC 9(4) OCCURS 5.
       01 FRONT-IDX PIC 9(4) VALUE 1.
       01 REAR-IDX PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 COUNT-IDX PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 I PIC 9(4).
       01 VAL-OUT PIC 9(4).
       01 ELEM PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE 10 TO ELEM
           PERFORM ENQUEUE
           MOVE 20 TO ELEM
           PERFORM ENQUEUE
           MOVE 30 TO ELEM
           PERFORM ENQUEUE
           PERFORM DEQUEUE
           PERFORM PRINT-Q
           STOP RUN.
       ENQUEUE.
           IF COUNT-IDX < 5
               ADD 1 TO REAR-IDX
               IF REAR-IDX > 5 MOVE 1 TO REAR-IDX END-IF
               MOVE ELEM TO Q-ARR(REAR-IDX)
               ADD 1 TO COUNT-IDX
           END-IF.
       DEQUEUE.
           IF COUNT-IDX > 0
               MOVE Q-ARR(FRONT-IDX) TO VAL-OUT
               DISPLAY 'DEQ: ' VAL-OUT
               ADD 1 TO FRONT-IDX
               IF FRONT-IDX > 5 MOVE 1 TO FRONT-IDX END-IF
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM COUNT-IDX
           END-IF.
       PRINT-Q.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > COUNT-IDX
               COMPUTE VAL-OUT = FRONT-IDX + I - 1
               IF VAL-OUT > 5 SUBTRACT 5 FROM VAL-OUT END-IF
               DISPLAY Q-ARR(VAL-OUT)
           END-PERFORM.

examples.titleAr: قراءة عدد ثم ذلك العدد من الأسطر
examples.titleEn: Read Count Then That Many Lines
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة عدد صحيح ثم قراءة عدد من الأسطر النصية وعرضها مع ترقيم.
examples.descEn: Learn to read an integer count, then read that many text lines and display them numbered.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READN.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 N PIC 9(3).
       01 I PIC 9(3).
       01 LINE-IN PIC X(80).
       01 I-OUT PIC Z(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT N
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > N
               ACCEPT LINE-IN
               MOVE I TO I-OUT
               DISPLAY FUNCTION TRIM(I-OUT) ": " FUNCTION TRIM(LINE-IN)
           END-PERFORM
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة سطر نصي من لوحة المدخلات وعرضه داخل جملة ترحيب.
examples.descEn: Learn to read a text line from stdin and display it in a greeting.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GREET.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NAME PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY "Enter your name: " WITH NO ADVANCING
           ACCEPT WS-NAME
           DISPLAY "Hello, " FUNCTION TRIM(WS-NAME) "!"
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة أسطر نصية متتالية حتى نهاية المدخلات باستخدام ACCEPT مع حالة النهاية.
examples.descEn: Learn to read consecutive text lines until end-of-input using ACCEPT with end condition.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. READEOF.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 LINE-IN PIC X(80).
       01 EOF-FLAG PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01 LINE-OUT PIC X(80).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM UNTIL EOF-FLAG = 'Y'
               ACCEPT LINE-IN
               IF LINE-IN = SPACES
                   MOVE 'Y' TO EOF-FLAG
               ELSE
                   MOVE LINE-IN TO LINE-OUT
                   DISPLAY FUNCTION TRIM(LINE-OUT)
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           STOP RUN.

examples.titleEn: Reverse a String Using a Loop
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب كيفية عكس ترتيب أحرف نص بسيط باستخدام حلقة PERFORM وترميز الأحرف.
examples.descEn: Learn to reverse a simple string using a PERFORM loop and character indexing.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. REVERSE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STR PIC X(10) VALUE 'HELLO'.
       01 WS-REV PIC X(10).
       01 WS-I PIC 9(2).
       01 WS-J PIC 9(2).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1 TO WS-J.
           PERFORM VARYING WS-I FROM 10 BY -1 UNTIL WS-I = 0
               MOVE WS-STR(WS-I:1) TO WS-REV(WS-J:1)
               ADD 1 TO WS-J
           END-PERFORM
           DISPLAY WS-REV
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب أن المتغيرات في البرنامج الفرعي مستقلة عن البرنامج الرئيسي.
examples.descEn: Learn that variables in a subprogram are independent from the main program.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SCOPE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-X PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'BEFORE CALL: ' WS-X.
           CALL 'CHANGE'.
           DISPLAY 'AFTER CALL: ' WS-X.
           STOP RUN.
       END PROGRAM SCOPE.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CHANGE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-X PIC 9(2) VALUE 10.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'INSIDE SUB: ' WS-X.
           EXIT PROGRAM.
       END PROGRAM CHANGE.
examples.expectedStdout:
BEFORE CALL: 05
INSIDE SUB: 10
AFTER CALL: 05

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب كيفية محاكاة المكدس بمصفوفة ثابتة وعمليات الدفع والسحب والطباعة.
examples.descEn: Learn to simulate a stack with a fixed array and push, pop, and print operations.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. STACK.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 STACK-ARR PIC 9(4) OCCURS 10.
       01 TOP-IDX PIC 9(4) VALUE 0.
       01 I PIC 9(4).
       01 VAL-OUT PIC 9(4).
       01 ELEM PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE 10 TO ELEM
           PERFORM PUSH
           MOVE 20 TO ELEM
           PERFORM PUSH
           MOVE 30 TO ELEM
           PERFORM PUSH
           PERFORM POP
           PERFORM PRINT-STACK
           STOP RUN.
       PUSH.
           ADD 1 TO TOP-IDX
           MOVE ELEM TO STACK-ARR(TOP-IDX).
       POP.
           IF TOP-IDX > 0
               MOVE STACK-ARR(TOP-IDX) TO VAL-OUT
               DISPLAY 'POP: ' VAL-OUT
               SUBTRACT 1 FROM TOP-IDX
           END-IF.
       PRINT-STACK.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > TOP-IDX
               DISPLAY STACK-ARR(I)
           END-PERFORM.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام عبارة STRING وUNSTRING لاستخراج جزء من نص بناءً على مواضع محددة.
examples.descEn: Learn to use STRING and UNSTRING to extract a substring based on positions.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SUBSTRING.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TEXT PIC X(30) VALUE 'HELLO COBOL WORLD'.
       01 WS-START PIC 9(2) VALUE 7.
       01 WS-LENGTH PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01 WS-RESULT PIC X(30).
       01 WS-TEMP PIC X(30).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE WS-TEXT TO WS-TEMP.
           MOVE SPACES TO WS-RESULT.
           UNSTRING WS-TEMP DELIMITED BY ALL SPACE
               INTO WS-RESULT
               WITH POINTER WS-START
               TALLYING IN WS-LENGTH
           END-UNSTRING.
           DISPLAY WS-RESULT.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب كيفية تبادل قيمتين باستخدام الجمع والطرح دون متغير مؤقت.
examples.descEn: Learn how to swap two values using addition and subtraction without a temporary variable.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SWAP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 A PIC 9(2) VALUE 5.
       01 B PIC 9(2) VALUE 9.
       01 DISP-A PIC Z9.
       01 DISP-B PIC Z9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE A TO DISP-A
           MOVE B TO DISP-B
           DISPLAY "Before: A=" DISP-A " B=" DISP-B
           ADD A TO B
           SUBTRACT A FROM B GIVING A
           SUBTRACT A FROM B GIVING B
           MOVE A TO DISP-A
           MOVE B TO DISP-B
           DISPLAY "After:  A=" DISP-A " B=" DISP-B
           STOP RUN.
examples.expectedStdout:
Before: A= 5 B= 9
After:  A= 9 B= 5

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام FUNCTION TRIM لإزالة المسافات الزائدة من طرفي النص.
examples.descEn: Learn to use FUNCTION TRIM to remove extra spaces from both ends of a string.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TRIM.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STR PIC X(20) VALUE '  HELLO  '.
       01 WS-RES PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE FUNCTION TRIM(WS-STR) TO WS-RES
           DISPLAY WS-RES
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تحويل قيمة رقمية إلى نصية للعرض بدون أصفار بادئة.
examples.descEn: Learn to convert a numeric value to a string for display without leading zeros.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CONVERT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-NUM PIC 9(3) VALUE 42.
       01 WS-STR PIC Z(3).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE WS-NUM TO WS-STR.
           DISPLAY 'VALUE: ' WS-STR.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام دالة FUNCTION UPPER-CASE لتحويل النص إلى أحرف كبيرة.
examples.descEn: Learn to use FUNCTION UPPER-CASE to convert a string to uppercase.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. UPPER.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-STR PIC X(20) VALUE 'hello world'.
       01 WS-RES PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(WS-STR) TO WS-RES
           DISPLAY WS-RES
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام INSPECT لتحويل جميع الأحرف الصغيرة إلى كبيرة.
examples.descEn: Learn to use INSPECT to convert all lowercase letters to uppercase.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. UPPERCASE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-TEXT PIC X(20) VALUE 'hello world'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           INSPECT WS-TEXT CONVERTING 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
               TO 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
           DISPLAY WS-TEXT.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تعريف متغيرات من أنواع مختلفة (رقمية، نصية، عشرية) وعرضها في كوبول.
examples.descEn: Learn to define variables of different types (numeric, alphanumeric, decimal) and display them in COBOL.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VARS.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-AGE      PIC 9(2) VALUE 20.
       01 WS-NAME     PIC X(10) VALUE 'AHMAD'.
       01 WS-GPA      PIC 9V99 VALUE 3.75.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           DISPLAY 'AGE: ' WS-AGE.
           DISPLAY 'NAME: ' WS-NAME.
           DISPLAY 'GPA: ' WS-GPA.
           STOP RUN.

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام PERFORM UNTIL لتكرار حتى يتحقق شرط، مع عدّاد.
examples.descEn: Learn to use PERFORM UNTIL to repeat until a condition is met, with a counter.
examples.code:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. WHILELOOP.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-COUNT PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.
       01 WS-SUM PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM UNTIL WS-COUNT > 5
               ADD WS-COUNT TO WS-SUM
               ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT
           END-PERFORM.
           DISPLAY 'SUM = ' WS-SUM.
           STOP RUN.
